testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select multiple drawing files and return to one ✔ Given writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder ✔ And the user opens and saves each drawing to establish its sheet preview, then closes the drawings ✔ Given the Open dialog in the MCAD Software displays two adjacent saved drawings as thumbnails ✔ And each drawing has a saved sheet preview ✔ And the dialog folder contains adjacent `OpenDrawingA.odd` and `OpenDrawingB.odd` thumbnails ✔ When the user drags a selection rectangle from empty list space across both thumbnails ✔ Then both drawing thumbnails are selected ✔ And the status area reports two selected items ✔ And the file name field contains both drawing names in quotes ✔ And the separate preview area displays a placeholder ✔ And individual drawing loading options are not displayed ✔ When the user selects one of the drawing thumbnails ✔ Then only that drawing is selected ✔ And the file name field identifies that drawing ✔ And its sheet preview and drawing loading options are displayed ✔ And the Open dialog remains open
